# iosxe_wireless_system (Resource)

This resource can manage the Wireless System configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_wireless_system" "example" {
  interface_name = "Vlan10"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `interface_name` (String) Wireless management interface name

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_wireless_system.example ""
```
